events.text: A new food stall in town sells skewers so good there is a queue down the street.

effects.log: Worth every minute.
Free skewers forever, in exchange for listening to his life story.

events.text: An illiterate farmer asks you to write a letter to his son in the army.

effects.log: It is full of love and misspelled in his accent. You leave it that way.
His son writes back that it was the best letter he ever got.

events.text: A merchant's cart has lost a wheel on the road. His goods are spilling into the mud.

effects.log: He gives you a jar of pickles. They are excellent.
Somebody else helps. You feel slightly worse.

events.text: The bird market: cages of songbirds, each singing for a buyer.

choices.text: Buy a bird and set it free

effects.log: It flies over the rooftops. The seller shakes his head. (−2 taels)
A hundred birds, one song.

events.text: The temple fortune sticks predict 'great luck, great danger' for you this year.

effects.log: You are more careful all year.

choices.text: Shake again for a better one

effects.log: The second stick says "Stop shaking sticks." You do.

events.text: Rain for a week. You are stuck at a village inn with a group of travelling actors.

effects.log: By the end of the week you have a small part and a new nickname.
A week of training. The actors applaud your forms.

events.text: A lost child cries on the roadside. Their village is two valleys away.

effects.log: A long walk. A grateful family. A child who never forgets.

choices.text: Take them to the nearest constable

effects.log: Sensible. The constable finds the family by evening.

events.text: A tattooist offers to ink a dragon on your back. Many murim folk have one.

effects.log: It takes three days and hurts like a duel. It looks magnificent. (−8 taels)
Your skin stays your own. The tattooist shrugs and draws on the next customer.

events.text: An old drunk in the tavern moves strangely when he stumbles, like a snake.

choices.text: Buy him a drink and watch

effects.log: Drunken Fist, real and rare. You pick up one move.
He falls over your foot, and somehow you end up on the floor.

events.text: Two merchants fight over a customer. The customer is you.

effects.log: Everyone is happy. Your house is full of turnips.
You buy nothing and enjoy the show.

events.text: You decide to build a table yourself.

ok.log: A good table. Slightly crooked. Yours.

fail.log: It wobbles. You eat on it for twenty years out of pride.

effects.log: A perfect table. No pride at all. (−5 taels)

events.text: A toothache keeps you awake for three nights.

effects.log: One pull, a scream, relief. (−3 taels)
You numb it with your breath. It comes back every winter.

events.text: Your robe is more patch than robe. It might be time.

effects.log: People treat you differently in it. You are not sure you like that. (−15 taels)
The patches have patches. It has character.

events.text: The neighbour's cat has decided your house is its house.

effects.log: It sleeps on your chest. You have two homes to feed now.
It is back by noon. Every day. For years.

events.text: Two young swordsmen draw on each other in the marketplace over nothing.

effects.log: Nobody innocent gets hurt. That matters most.

events.text: You decide to walk to the next town instead of taking the ferry.

effects.log: Birds, fields, a free peach from a farmer.

choices.text: Walk fast and train your legs

effects.log: You arrive early and very tired.

events.text: A scholar in the teahouse insists martial artists are all fools.

ok.log: He buys you tea and reconsiders his life.

fail.log: He wins. You decide to read more.

effects.log: He is disarmed. He was hoping for a fight.

events.text: An old woman sells the same flowers every day at the same corner. Today she has none.

effects.log: Her garden flooded. You help her replant.
She tells you her garden flooded. She smiles for the first time today.

events.text: The innkeeper swears the room you are sleeping in is haunted by a weeping bride.

effects.log: You hear weeping at midnight. It is the innkeeper's daughter, who is in love with a soldier.
The innkeeper looks disappointed. The ghost is his best advertising.

events.text: A rich merchant tells you the secret of wealth: 'Never spend.'

effects.log: You save a lot, and have a very boring year. (+15 taels)
You spend on friends and wine. No regrets.

events.text: The blacksmith has burned his hand and has a big order to finish.

choices.text: Work his bellows for a week

effects.log: Your arms burn. His order is finished. He sharpens your blade for free forever.
You find a strong boy who wanted the work.

events.text: Villagers tie wishes to an old tree on red ribbons.

effects.log: You wish for something you cannot say out loud.
Health, love, rice. Everyone wants the same things.

events.text: A card sharp at the inn beats everyone at a game with rules nobody quite understands.

effects.log: You spot the trick. You say nothing and never play.
He leaves town that night.

events.text: The old ferryman has taken travellers across the river for fifty years. Today he is too ill to row.

effects.log: A day of rowing. The ferryman gives you a blessing and a fish.
He recovers, and never charges you again.

events.text: A shop owner asks you to write the name of his new shop on the sign.

ok.log: People stop to admire the sign. The shop does well.

fail.log: It is legible. That is enough.

effects.log: Honest. The shop owner thanks you.

events.text: The wine at this inn tastes like vinegar and regret.

effects.log: The innkeeper brings the good jar from the back.
The tea is worse. A story, at least.

events.text: A travelling merchant sells bronze mirrors. You see your face clearly for the first time in years.

effects.log: You look older, and wiser, and in need of a haircut. (−4 taels)
Some things are better not seen too often.

events.text: Two old men argue in the street about whether the sword or the spear is the king of weapons.

effects.log: The sword man buys you tea.

choices.text: Say the best weapon is a good meal

effects.log: Both men laugh and invite you to lunch.

events.text: The village temple needs repairs, and the monks are too poor to pay.

effects.log: A week of carpentry. The monks chant for you.
New tiles and a grateful abbot. (−10 taels)

events.text: You disturb a beehive while walking in the woods.

fail.log: A dozen stings. You look like a steamed bun.

effects.log: Wet, but unstung. Mostly.

events.text: The town crier announces that a famous master will perform in the square tomorrow.

effects.log: The master performs one form. You understand a little more.
A profitable day. (+6 taels)

events.text: Winter comes early and hard. The poor quarter is freezing.

effects.log: A child wears it all winter.

choices.text: Organise firewood for the poor quarter

effects.log: A week of work. Nobody freezes on your street.

events.text: A crow follows you for three days, cawing every time you make a mistake.

effects.log: It brings you shiny things. You are not sure where from.
You are more careful. The crow seems satisfied.

events.text: A grandmother at the market insists you are too thin and gives you rice cakes.

effects.log: You are not too thin any more.
She is delighted and pinches your cheek.

events.text: A letter from your old village teacher: he is retiring and wants to know how you turned out.

effects.log: He writes back: "I always knew." He did not, but it is kind.
He cries when he sees you.

events.text: The actors in a street play are doing a fight scene badly. The crowd is booing.

effects.log: The best fight scene the town has ever seen.
You enjoy it more than you should.

events.text: A merchant sells you rice with stones mixed in.

effects.log: He refunds you, grumbling.

ok.log: The whole market hears. His sales collapse.

fail.log: He calls the constable on you instead.

events.text: Everything goes right today. Every door opens, every coin lands face-up.

effects.log: It does nothing. The luck was for something else.
Every good deed lands perfectly.

events.text: Everything goes wrong today. You trip, spill, and lose a sandal.

effects.log: By evening it is the funniest day of the year.
Tomorrow is a new day.

events.text: In a pawnshop you see a sword you once lost, years ago.

effects.log: It still fits your hand. (−10 taels)
It has a new story now.
